title: Al-Kahf 18:6-10 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Tajweed mastery and Al-Kahf consolidation
source: Written for quran/y11 lesson 4 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Kahf 18:6-10 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 4. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ إِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا (٦) إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ زِينَةًۭ لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا (٧) وَإِنَّا لَجَٰعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيْهَا صَعِيدًۭا جُرُزًا (٨) أَمْ حَسِبْتَ أَنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْكَهْفِ وَٱلرَّقِيمِ كَانُوا۟ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا عَجَبًا (٩) إِذْ أَوَى ٱلْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةًۭ وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًۭا (١٠)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muhammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow.
Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.
And indeed, We will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground.
Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were, among Our signs, a wonder?
[Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, "Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance."

keywords.def: the inscription (or the name linked with the people of the cave)

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Kahf 18:6-10 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 18:6-10 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 18:6-10 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: In the portal box, write the du'a of 18:10 in Arabic and its meaning, and when you might use it.
questions.a: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةًۭ وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًۭا: before a decision or exam.

questions.q: What did the youths ask for in 18:10?
questions.a: A) Mercy and right guidance. 18:10: 'grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance'.

questions.q: Al-Kahf 18:9: «أَمْ حَسِبْتَ أَنَّ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Young men left everything and took shelter in a cave, praying for mercy and guidance. What would make someone do that?
questions.a: Protecting their faith; they asked Allah for mercy and right guidance (18:10).
